problem: The daily Wet DBA blog reached main without the deterministic English cache entries required by the static locale build, causing STATIC_I18N_CACHE_INCOMPLETE and blocking unrelated website delivery.
root_cause: The blog publication path committed new translatable Dutch copy without committing the matching append-only static English cache patch before merge.
decision: Treat translation-cache completeness as part of the same publication artifact. Recover the 66 missing entries and retain an executable historical replay for this incident dataset.
prevention: A Dutch public route is not delivery-complete while required static English cache entries are missing.
The exact historical set of 66 missing Wet DBA strings is retained as an append-only cache patch.
Executable replay verifies count, representative mappings and non-empty translated values.
